paragraphs.text: This is my little cart. It is red and old. I like it a lot.
paragraphs.translation: 这是我的小推车。它红红的，有点旧。我特别喜欢它。

paragraphs.text: The apple trees are very big. There are many apples on them. Some apples are red. Some apples are green.
paragraphs.translation: 苹果树又高又大。树上结满了苹果。有些苹果是红的，有些苹果是绿的。

paragraphs.text: My sister has a basket. She puts apples in it. She can pick ten apples. She is very happy.
paragraphs.translation: 妹妹有一个篮子。她把苹果放进篮子里。她能摘十个苹果。她开心极了。

paragraphs.text: My dog sits by the cart. He smells the sweet apples. He can smell them well. But he does not eat them.
paragraphs.translation: 我的小狗坐在推车旁边。它闻着甜甜的苹果。它的鼻子可灵了。可它不吃苹果。

paragraphs.text: We put the basket in the cart. The cart is full of apples. It is very heavy now.
paragraphs.translation: 我们把篮子放进推车里。推车装满了苹果。现在它变得很重。

paragraphs.text: Dad pulls the cart home. Mom makes apple juice. We drink it together. What a nice day!
paragraphs.translation: 爸爸把推车拉回家。妈妈榨了苹果汁。我们一起喝果汁。今天真开心！
